notes.title: Cherophobia 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
1. Achievements now pop instantly.
2. Fresh input prompts with device specific icons.
3. Added subtitles for lines spoken outside of the main dialogue system.
4. Increased shadow split distance in the woods.
5. ubershaders and a precaching pipeline to reduce stutter.
6. Fixed a minor issue with the Paranoia achievement.
7. Fixed a bug in yesterday’s unanounced build that could break the game during the phone call scene.
8. Various minor improvements and adjustments.

notes.title: Cherophobia 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!  

We’re excited to bring you an update packed with fixes and improvements based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new:  

🌲 [b]Trees Load Instantly[/b]
No more waiting for nature to catch up! Trees now appear right away, smoothing out your journey through the world.  

⛰️ [b]No More Cliffhanger Glitches[/b]
We’ve fixed an issue where adventurous players could break the game by reaching the map’s cliff. Feel free to explore—but within limits. 

🏠 [b]House Crash Fixed[/b]
If you were testing your speed entering and exiting the house, you might have run into a crash. Not anymore! This issue has been resolved for a seamless experience.  

🌐 [b]Menu Focus Improvements[/b]
The menu now focuses on the current language.

💊 [b]Clearer Pill-Taking Prompt[/b]
To avoid confusion, we’ve refined the pill-taking prompt.


As always, your feedback is invaluable. Let us know how the new changes feel, and don’t forget to leave a review if you’re enjoying the game.  

Stay tuned for more updates!  

~ Worst Event

notes.title: Our New Short Roguelike Deckbuilder Horror Experience
notes.content:
Our new game, Do You Have a Moment to Talk About Our Lord and Savior, is out now! Get it on sale during the Winter Sales!

Step into a short yet intense rogue-like card game with deck-building mechanics. Trapped by a wicked man, you must win his deadly card game to earn your freedom. The rules are simple:

[b]Draw Without Fear[/b]: Pull as many cards as you dare, but if you draw the same color twice, your hand burns to ashes!
[b]Master the Deck[/b]: Unlock SPECIAL CARDS to craft the perfect strategy.
[b]Face the Challenge[/b]: Survive to [b]Level 13[/b] and break free!

Ready to gamble for your freedom? Start playing today!
